description: Brick wall from x = 0 to x = wall_length: individual bricks in running, stack, English or Flemish bond, cut to the wall ends and top, with random offset, yaw and tint, standing slightly proud of a recessed mortar core. One wythe deep (headers are drawn as half bricks). Pivot at the start of the wall, on the ground, centred in thickness. Pieces: brick_wall_bricks (brick), brick_wall_mortar (mortar). Every piece is a closed box.

brick_length.desc: brick length (m); depth is half of it

jitter.desc: random offset and yaw of each brick (0 = perfect)

brick_pts.note: lay each course left to right from the bond's unit sequence and start offset, clipping bricks at x = 0, x = wall_length and the top

params.code: const m = JSON.parse(detail(0, 'materials') || '{}')[s@material]; if (!m) return; const k = haspointattrib(0, 'tint') ? point(0, 'tint', primpoints(0, @primnum)[0]) || 1 : 1; @Cd = mul(m.baseColor, k);
